assessment.headline: A comparison shows a volume difference against the bill; the contractual rating basis is unresolved.
A survey establishes a measured volume of 0.75 CBM against a billed volume of 1.10 CBM, but the contractual rating basis remains unresolved.
assessment.reason: Survey data D4 (F18) and calculation C5-C8 now provide a measured volume of 0.75 CBM, shifting the comparison from declared to measured volume.

assessment.headline: A contract term with a 1.00 CBM minimum partially explains the billed volume, leaving a smaller discrepancy against the bill.
assessment.reason: The introduction of contract term D5 establishing a 1.00 CBM minimum volume allows a revised comparison showing that the contractual baseline accounts for most of the billed charge.
